name: Paragraph
description: Body text for content paragraphs, descriptions, and long-form reading. Regular weight by default. Optimized for readability.

size.description: Paragraph size. Maps to text scale tokens.

truncate.description: Truncate with ellipsis on a single line

do: Use Paragraph for body text, descriptions, and content blocks
Use size='sm' for secondary text and captions
doNot: Do not use Paragraph for UI labels — use Label
Do not use Paragraph for headings — use Heading or Display
